name: dev.openpencil/mcp
title: OpenPencil
description: Read, create, and edit designs in the running OpenPencil editor, and export them.

environmentVariables.name: OPENPENCIL_MCP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory that file tools may read and write. Defaults to the current working directory, or the home directory on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: OPENPENCIL_MCP_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Set to "selection" to let the client read only the selected layers. Defaults to the app setting.
